data.name: ContentSecurityPolicyDigestInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not a base64 digest (ALPHA / DIGIT / '+' / '/' / '-' / '_', up to two '=' of padding).

data.name: CspDirectiveNameInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not a CSP directive name (letters, digits and '-').

data.name: ContentSecurityPolicyDirectiveRequired
data.value: A Content Security Policy needs at least one directive.

data.name: CspDirectiveValueInvalid
data.value: The value of {0} contains a character the CSP directive-value grammar excludes (',', ';', a control character, or non-ASCII).

data.name: ContentSecurityPolicyHostSourceInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not a CSP host source ([scheme://]host[:port][/path], no whitespace, ',' or ';'). Use Scheme() for a scheme-only source and the keyword methods for quoted keywords.

data.name: ContentSecurityPolicyNonceInvalid
data.value: The Content Security Policy nonce supplied by the installed ISecurityHeadersFeature is not a CSP base64-value (ALPHA / DIGIT / '+' / '/' / '-' / '_', up to two '=' of padding), so it cannot be written into a header.

data.name: ContentSecurityPolicyNoneConflict
data.value: The {0} source list combines 'none' with other sources, and user agents ignore 'none' beside them. Use None() alone, or remove it.

data.name: ContentSecurityPolicySchemeInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not a scheme source; a scheme is ALPHA *( ALPHA / DIGIT / '+' / '-' / '.' ), optionally followed by ':'.

data.name: ContentSecurityPolicySourceRequired
data.value: The {0} source list is empty. Add a source, or call None() to match nothing.

data.name: FrameAncestorRequired
data.value: Name at least one ancestor source; use FramingPolicy.Deny to forbid every frame.

data.name: FrameAncestorSourceInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not a frame-ancestors source; use 'self', a scheme source (https:), or a host source (https://partner.example.com). Use FramingPolicy.Deny for 'none'.

data.name: FrameAncestorsOwnedByFramingPolicy
data.value: frame-ancestors is owned by SecurityHeadersPolicy.Framing, which emits it together with a matching X-Frame-Options field.

data.name: PermissionsPolicyFeatureNameInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not a policy-controlled feature name (lowercase letters, digits, '_', '-', '.' and '*', starting with a letter).

data.name: PermissionsPolicyFeatureRequired
data.value: A Permissions Policy needs at least one feature.

data.name: PermissionsPolicyOriginInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not a serialized origin (scheme://host[:port], no path); use AllowAll() for every origin.

data.name: PermissionsPolicyOriginRequired
data.value: Name at least one origin; use Disable() to allow none.

data.name: ReportingEndpointNameInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not a reporting endpoint name (an RFC 9110 token).

data.name: ReportUriInvalid
data.value: '{0}' is not a report URL (a URI reference without whitespace, ',' or ';').

data.name: ReportUriRequired
data.value: report-uri needs at least one URL.

data.name: SandboxKeywordInvalid
